# TestRung

> Turn one idea into the cheapest test that could prove it wrong.

TestRung is an open source web app for researchers. Paste a prediction, get a test ladder cheapest first, a cost, kill criteria, and a next step, in under a minute.

## Key facts

- Stack: Next.js 15.5.9, React 19, TypeScript, plain CSS. No component library, no database, no model call in v1.
- The DRPLA example: LSD1 inhibition lowers mutant ATN1 and rescues DRPLA, TAK-418 at 1 mg/kg/day in AT-FL-65Q mice, rotarod at 4 months. Total about $1,800 for Rungs 1 to 4. Rung 1 free literature, Rung 2 free public data, Rung 3 one cell test about $1,200, Rung 4 confirm about $600. Mouse test is a locked Rung 5, quote needed, not in the total.
- Kill criteria are first class: every ladder says what would prove the idea wrong, and when to stop.
- Costs are planning estimates, not quotes. A lab must review the preregistration draft before use.
- License: MIT.

## Files

- README.md: what it is, how to run it, screenshots, roadmap
- ARCHITECTURE.md: architecture, and an honest note on the Gemini 4 Neon attempt
- docs/cheapest-place-brainstorm.md: Opus 5.5 design for a Numbeo-style cheapest-place comparison
- brand/BRAND.md: name, logo, colours, voice
- app/page.tsx: the whole one-screen flow
- lib/ladder.ts: ladder engine, cost model, kill criteria, export text
- lib/generate.ts: generation interface, ready for Gemini 4 Neon in v2
- lib/strings.ts: all user-facing copy in one place

## Run it

```bash
npm install
npm run dev
```

Open http://localhost:3000

## Optional

- Brand: TestRung, domain testrung.nshipyard.com (a subdomain of nshipyard.com)
- Project: RareGap (raregap.ai)
